title: Godba
identity: DSS’s 2012 catalogue lists Uroš Rojko’s Godba for alto saxophone and piano, edition DSS 1362, with a listed duration of 15 minutes. The edition-number register gives publication by DSS in 2003. The work-list entry prints “Godba (1954)” under the composer heading “Rojko, Uroš (1954),” so the composition date remains unresolved.

evidence.claim: The edition-number register identifies Ed. DSS 1362 as Uroš Rojko, Godba, published in Ljubljana by DSS in 2003. This provides the publication year, while the separate work-list entry’s parenthetical 1954 remains ambiguous.

review_focus: Inspect the score for register, articulation, technical devices, and the relationship between saxophone and piano.
gaps: The work-list parenthetical 1954 is ambiguous and does not independently establish a composition year; the edition register confirms publication in 2003. The official catalogue provides scoring and approximate duration but no readable notation. No verified recording or college-program listing was found.
